Bhoza

Marketing / Events / Artist management
Social / MC, DJ, speaker / Consulting

In kasi slang, a bhoza is the one in charge. In this industry, that is whoever holds the running order.

Managing artists since 2003

For more than twenty years Bhoza Mphela has held it for artists, brands, venues and audiences across South African music, events, marketing and media.

The running order

Six things I do, in the order a night actually needs them.

  1. Q1 Before doors Marketing and brand strategy Brand positioning, campaign strategy, communications and audience engagement. Go →
  2. Q2 The line-up Artist management Artist strategy, career development, bookings, positioning and industry navigation. Go →
  3. Q3 The build Events and experiences Event concepts, production, marketing, partnerships and audience experiences. Go →
  4. Q4 The noise Social media and content Social media strategy, content planning, storytelling and digital campaigns. Go →
  5. Q5 Showtime MC, DJ, speaker Hosting, DJing, moderating conversations and sharing practical creative-industry knowledge. Go →
  6. Q6 The debrief Creative industry consulting Strategic support for creatives, organisations and brands working across the creative economy. Go →
